    How it fits together

    From first click to booked visit.

    1. Add a tool

      A widget on your site answers the question customers ask most: what rebates can I get, or what will this cost?

    2. Capture the lead

      To see their full result, visitors leave their email and project details. It goes straight to your sales team.

    3. Book the visit

      Your team follows up with a quote or an on-site assessment, already knowing what the customer wants.

    4. Drive traffic

      Digital ads send the right homeowners to the tool, and you see the cost of every lead in plain numbers.

    What we build

    Tools your customers will actually use.

    Each one is built for your business, matches your brand, and works on any website. One-time fee, no subscription.

    Rebate finders

    Show homeowners the rebates and financing they may qualify for, then collect their details for a quote or assessment.

    Cost estimators

    A ballpark price for a roof, deck or window package in a minute, so serious buyers raise their hand.

    Product match quizzes

    Assessment booking

    Financing calculators

    How it works

    Live on your site in weeks, not months.

    1. Talk

      A short call about the question your customers ask most and how your team follows up.

    2. Build

      We build the tool around your products, service area and brand.

    3. Install

      A small snippet added to your site. It works with WordPress, Wix, Squarespace and the rest.

    4. Collect leads

      Every submission goes to your inbox or CRM with the customer's answers attached.

    5. Add traffic

      Pair it with a digital ad campaign that sends the right homeowners straight to the tool.
